lines.text: In the evening, a rich disciple named Joseph from Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a clean linen cloth and laid it in his own new tomb.
Joseph rolled a great log across the tomb entrance, while Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat opposite.
The next day, the chief priests and Pharisees asked Pilate to secure the tomb, fearing the crowds would riot at it.

wrong_details.wrong: the crowds would riot at the tomb
wrong_details.true: His disciples may come and steal Him away

lines.text: Pilate told them to make the tomb as secure as they knew how, so they sealed the stone and posted the guard.
